summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has become the open standard for connecting AI agents to external tools, data sources, and services, with its TypeScript and Python SDKs reaching 97 million monthly downloads by March 2026 — a 4,750% growth in 16 months. The ecosystem spans aggregator platforms that bundle thousands of integrations behind one endpoint, gateways that secure and route traffic, and individual servers that expose specific capabilities like browser automation or repo access. For AI agents, MCP matters because it standardizes tool access, reduces credential risk via OAuth-secured remote servers, and lets vendors ship updates without user reinstalls.
ecosystem_note: Aggregators (e.g. Composio, Smithery) expose hundreds or thousands of apps through a single managed endpoint; gateways (e.g. Cloudflare, agentgateway) sit in front of servers to handle auth, routing, and security; individual servers (e.g. Playwright, GitHub, Figma) each connect an agent to one specific tool or platform.

tools.name: Playwright MCP
tools.connects_to: Browser automation via 25+ tools using accessibility-tree snapshots (no vision models or screenshots needed); runs in CI/CD such as GitHub Actions
strengths: Reliable automation without writing Playwright code
tools.best_for: AI-driven browser automation and end-to-end testing

tools.name: Figma MCP
tools.connects_to: Design files, components, and layout data for design-to-code and asset workflows via OAuth-secured remote server
tools.pricing_paid: Included with Figma plans; Figma paid tiers from ~$12/editor/month
tools.best_for: Turning design files into code and extracting design context for agents

tools.name: GitHub MCP
tools.connects_to: Repositories, issues, pull requests, code search, and Actions via OAuth-secured remote server
tools.pricing_paid: Free; tied to GitHub plans (Team/Enterprise from ~$4/user/month)
tools.best_for: Agent-driven code review, issue triage, and repo automation

tools.name: Context7
tools.connects_to: Up-to-date, version-specific library documentation and code examples injected into agent context
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier; paid usage via Upstash plans
tools.best_for: Feeding current library docs to coding agents like Cursor and Claude

tools.name: Composio
tools.connects_to: One endpoint for 1,500+ apps with managed authentication, structured schemas, and dynamic tool routing
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier; usage-based and team plans available
strengths: 1B+ tool calls run on the platform
Self-learning layer improves tool selection over time
30% more accurate on 2x fewer tokens for repeat tasks
tools.best_for: Giving agents broad, managed access to many SaaS apps through a single integration

tools.name: Supabase MCP
tools.connects_to: Postgres databases, auth, storage, and edge functions via OAuth-secured remote server
tools.best_for: Letting agents query and manage Postgres-backed application data

tools.name: Notion MCP
tools.connects_to: Notion pages, databases, and docs for reading and writing knowledge-base content via OAuth remote server
tools.best_for: Agent-driven documentation, notes, and knowledge management

tools.name: n8n MCP
tools.connects_to: Workflow automation engine letting agents trigger and build multi-step automations across hundreds of nodes
tools.best_for: Connecting agents to complex, self-hosted automation workflows

tools.name: Zapier MCP
tools.connects_to: Thousands of apps via Zapier's integration catalog through a single MCP endpoint
tools.best_for: Giving agents instant access to a huge catalog of consumer and business apps

tools.name: Jira MCP
tools.connects_to: Jira issues, projects, sprints, and workflows for agent-driven project management
tools.best_for: Agent-assisted issue tracking and project management

tools.name: Cloudflare MCP
tools.connects_to: Hosting and securing remote MCP servers with OAuth, plus access to Cloudflare Workers, R2, D1, and KV
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier; Workers paid plans from $5/month
strengths: Managed OAuth and remote server hosting
tools.best_for: Deploying and securing remote MCP servers at the edge

tools.name: Atlassian MCP
tools.connects_to: Confluence and Jira content via a unified OAuth-secured remote server for docs and project data
tools.pricing_paid: Free; included with Atlassian Cloud paid plans
tools.best_for: Agent access to enterprise documentation and project management in the Atlassian suite
